observability_triage.rationale: The client explicitly permits two schematic outcomes. The actual SDA/SCL graph can deterministically satisfy either an absent-resistor/direct-connection branch or a populated-pair/44-ohm series branch. The subjective phrase 'not obstructing anything' and external cable length are not separately scored.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The main-board SDA and SCL paths implement exactly one of two allowed topologies: (A) no populated series resistors and direct controller-to-bus connectivity on each signal, or (B) exactly one populated 44 Ω resistor in each signal path, with no bypass and a matching PCB footprint for both resistors.
